newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak Tatra Banka to lead Kazakh oil project loan.
newsitem.headline: Slovak Tatra Banka to lead Kazakh oil project loan.

text.p: Slovak commercial bank Tatra Banka a.s. said on Monday it would lead manage a $13.5 million syndicated loan for the Slovak-Kazakhstan oil exploitation joint-venture company J-SC ANACO a.s..

"The loan will be used for financing the Slovak-Kazakhstan project named Kyrykmyltyk, provided by J-SC ANACO," Tatra Banka spokesman Ivan Bednar told Reuters. He did not give any further details of the loan.
Other members of the syndicate are the Austrian Raiffeisen Zentralbank Osterreich AG Wien and Die Erste Osterreichische Spar-Casse-Bank AG, Bednar said.
Slovak oil and gas storage company Nafta a.s. is the majority owner of J-SC ANACO, which is based in Kazakhstan.
The joint-venture is aimed at managing the construction of devices for extracting crude oil in Kazakhstan.
